name: Caption plate (film-owned caption band)
purpose: One caption plate at a fixed height that the film owns, with the cue texts swapping inside it and the spoken word lit, instead of the runtime's floating per-cue plates (caption-band). For films whose layout reserves a band for captions.

inputs.name: cues
inputs.description: [{start, end, text, words?}] as `studio.py captions` writes them (window.STUDIO_CAPTIONS); measured words light as they are spoken

inputs.name: band
inputs.description: Fractions of the frame height; default a strip whose bottom edge is the safe bottom. Declare the same fractions in the style template's rules.caption_band

inputs.name: full
inputs.description: Edge to edge, or inside the safe sides

inputs.name: hold
inputs.description: Keep the plate after the last cue

implementation.api: Studio.comp.captionBand(parent, cues, {band, full, enterAt, hold, highlight}) -> {el, texts, band, schedule(tl) -> end time}

layout_notes: Band position is a fraction of the frame height per format (Studio.pick map); texts are padded by the safe insets and sized by --fs-caption. Texts carry class st-caption, so motion-qa waives them and the gap audit does not count them as picture changes.
validation_steps: python tests/test-studio-runtime.py (hidden before the first cue, swap inside one plate, word highlight, exit)

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-24. Not rendered through HyperFrames.
